note: The Bank of St Helena's rates, fees and charges (1 April 2026): no charge for keeping an account in use; only a dormant personal account pays (5 pounds a quarter), which the game doesn't count.

sources.said: Rates, Fees and Charges ... 1st April 2026 ... Easy Saver ( customer deposits up to £24,999) 1% ... Dormant Accounts (Quarterly Fees) ... Personal Accounts £5.00 ... Monthly Statement FREE
